## Procedure

1. Begin in the Athletic Stance (-14) straddling the starting line
2. When ready, shuffle to the first line (5 yards) and touch it with the outside hand (i.e., if facing left, touch the line with the right hand) (-38)
3. Shuffle back to the starting line and touch it with the outside hand
4. Shuffle to the second line (10 yards) and touch it with the outside hand
5. Shuffle back to the starting line and touch it with the outside hand
6. Shuffle to the first line again (5 yards), touch it with the outside hand then shuffle past the starting line
7. Perform this drill facing both the right and the left using the following distances: 10 yards - 5 yards - 10 yards, 5 yards - 5 yards - 5 yards, 5 yards - 10 yards - 15 yards, and 15 yards 10 yards - 5 yards
